# .CMPCT

> Project v0.29.0 · surface 0.29.c · canonical format r24.

CMPCT is an experimental general-purpose lossless archive/container. Performance is a core-release contract: benchmark wins and losses remain attached to committed evidence, while presentation-only changes use the alphabetic surface track.

## Publication authority
Canonical source and evidence live on `main`. `gh-pages` is generated static deployment output only and must not become a second source of truth.

## Qualification
The site distinguishes canonical revision-24 behavior from the research-frontier Mosaic/CMPNX11 results. Do not promote research-only grammar as canonical interoperability support. Raw archive-size comparisons do not imply feature parity.
